item.description:
See what each project spent of your allowance, and figures that keep up while you work.

  • Cost per project. A new Costs section shows what each project spent of each login's allowance, by day, week and month.
  • Figures that keep up: read fresh while a session works, with a countdown that follows the clock.
  • A menu bar item as wide as what it says.
  • Abacus.AI credits for custom endpoints.
  • OpenCode and Grok stay signed in.
  • Polished Português do Brasil.
